info.title: OpenLab local research API
info.description: Loopback only. Use the per-launch link to establish a local session. Mutations require Origin and x-openlab-csrf. Research records are authoritative; SSE attachment never starts work.

post.summary: Exchange the per-launch bootstrap token for an HttpOnly local session

get.summary: Read current CSRF token
List statically registered plugin manifests and preferences

patch.summary: Enable plugins and choose compatible defaults; active research blocks disabling execution providers

get.summary: Read actual compiler component preparation progress

post.summary: Prepare pinned, checksum-verified compiler components; contains no document inputs

delete.summary: Cancel compiler preparation, retaining validated cached components

get.summary: Download an immutable checksum-verified document resource or build output

post.summary: Create a manual document without creating a research run
Create an immutable human revision using an idempotent optimistic save

get.summary: Read the platform-owned unsent editor draft
List compilation records and exact input/output references

post.summary: Record browser compiler output; not scientific verification or a server execution attestation

get.summary: Read local runtime diagnostics and public provider configuration

post.summary: Check the fixed metadata provider without starting research

get.summary: List local projects
Read project, conversations, runs, sources and artifacts

patch.summary: Update independent project context, rename, archive or reopen

post.summary: Copy an inert attachment into project storage (10 MB maximum)

get.summary: Download checksum-verified original attachment bytes
Download a versioned portable research archive

post.summary: Verify and import an archive as historical records with new identities

get.summary: Read platform-owned messages and run history; optional run-group pagination

patch.summary: Rename a conversation without changing history

post.summary: Create a run once per request key with frozen, service-selected conversation context; agent requires a tested provider; metadata calls no model

materialIds.description: Agent mode: omitted uses project materials (frozen on first request); empty array uses none. Metadata mode reads no materials.

contextRevisionId.description: Optional exact revision from a finished run in this conversation; omitted selects the latest saved report when the run is created; null excludes report context.

get.summary: Read persisted run state and ordered events

post.summary: Confirm the current plan and its reviewed tool policy
Persist a validated question or scoped permission decision once
Request cancellation and await confirmed runtime termination

get.summary: Replay and subscribe to ordered domain events; never dispatch execution

200.description: SSE; id is the canonical sequence

post.summary: Attach an AG-UI consumer to an existing run; client state cannot change policy

get.summary: List public provider configuration; no credentials

post.summary: Store a user provider credential with Windows user-scoped protection; DeepSeek uses non-thinking mode

delete.summary: Remove an unused provider and its protected credential

patch.summary: Update an inactive provider; blank credential keeps the previous value; connection changes invalidate capability tests

post.summary: Verify real streaming and structured tool calls; uses provider tokens

get.summary: List built-in and installed skills with license, revision and maturity

post.summary: Install inert upstream files from an exact public Git commit
Enable task guidance after source/license review without granting executable code access

delete.summary: Remove an installation after its active runs have stopped; historical archives remain readable

get.summary: Read source evidence, access limitations and producing run/step links
List exact artifact revisions
Read the latest saved version, labeled mutable/incomplete where applicable

put.summary: Preserve an unsent editor draft without publishing a revision

delete.summary: Discard the unsent editing draft; published revisions remain immutable

get.summary: Read exact hashed immutable bytes and provenance

schemaVersion.description: Exports use v2; imports accept v1 and v2.
